title: A misunderstanding with another person
prompt: Talk about a time when there was a misunderstanding between you and another person. What caused the misunderstanding, and how was it resolved?
structure: What was said or done + how you understood it
How you felt + how the truth came out
How it was resolved + what you learned
modelAnswer:
I remember a funny misunderstanding I had with a coworker during my first year in Canada.

One afternoon, she said to me, 'We should grab coffee sometime.' Back home, if someone says that, it usually means they want to make a real plan. So the next morning, I went to her desk and asked what time she was free that day. She looked a bit surprised and said she was busy all week. I felt kind of hurt, because I thought she didn't really want to spend time with me.

A few days later, I mentioned it to another colleague. She laughed and explained that in Canada, 'We should grab coffee sometime' is often just a friendly thing to say, not an actual invitation.

After that, I felt much better. I told my coworker the whole story, and we both laughed about it. In the end, we actually did go for coffee the following week. Now, whenever someone says that, I just smile and say, 'Sounds good!'

usefulExpressions.expression: I remember a… I had with…
usefulExpressions.usageVi: Câu mở đầu giới thiệu câu chuyện một cách tự nhiên.
'Ở quê nhà' — rất hữu ích khi so sánh văn hóa Việt Nam và Canada.
'kind of' làm giảm nhẹ cảm xúc, nghe tự nhiên trong văn nói.
Kể kết quả cuối cùng của câu chuyện.
Kết nối câu chuyện quá khứ với thói quen hiện tại, tạo kết thúc hay.

commonMistakes: Kể sự việc nhưng không nói rõ NGUYÊN NHÂN gây hiểu lầm — đây là một trong hai câu hỏi chính của đề.
Lẫn lộn 'misunderstand' (động từ) và 'misunderstanding' (danh từ): 'There was a misunderstand' → 'There was a misunderstanding'.
Trích dẫn lời nói trực tiếp nhưng đổi thì sai. Khi kể lại, có thể dùng trích dẫn trực tiếp ('She said, We should…') để tránh lỗi lùi thì.
